questions.q: Which material is best for the core of an electromagnet?
questions.why: Soft iron is magnetised easily and loses its magnetism when the current is switched off (temporary magnet).

questions.q: What is the shape of the magnetic field around a long straight wire carrying a current?
options: straight lines parallel to the wire
straight lines pointing away from the wire
the same shape as a bar magnet's field
questions.why: The field lines are concentric circles centred on the wire; a solenoid gives the bar-magnet shape.

questions.q: Which change does NOT increase the turning effect on the coil of a d.c. motor?
questions.why: Reversing the current reverses the direction of rotation; it does not make the turning effect larger.

questions.q: State the function of the split-ring commutator in a d.c. motor.
questions.model: It reverses the current in the coil every half turn, so the coil keeps rotating in the same direction.
points: reverses the current in the coil
so the coil keeps turning the same way
